run_adsorb_atoms: run adsorb_atoms to relax an adslab system and compute adsorption energy using an ASE calculator
compute_hybrid_adsorption_energy: compute hybrid adsorption energy by combining ML-relaxed adslab energy with DFT slab energy and gas reference
compute_full_adsorption_energy: compute full adsorption energy by relaxing both the adslab and bare surface with an ML calculator
relax_adslab_with_optimizer: relax an adsorbate-slab atoms object using an ASE optimizer like LBFGS with a force convergence threshold
save_relaxed_atoms_json: save relaxed adslab and slab atoms as JSON-encoded strings in the adsorption results dictionary
